statements: <HOME>\config\settings.json is the single core persisted user-settings authority: versioned extensible JSON with minimum logical fields schema_version, service.host and service.port. General resolution is explicit CLI > ENV > settings.json > product default. Port: --port > TW_MARKET_PORT > service.port > 8000. Host: --host > TW_MARKET_HOST > service.host > 127.0.0.1, subject to inherited L4 loopback and valid-port bounds. A1 adds no resolver/public schema/Registry/YAML/TOML/dependency. Exact version encoding is a later implementation detail; compatible version recognition is required.

installation.json is local installation identity/path mapping; settings.json carries portable product preferences. Source-machine absolute paths must not be blindly restored as portable preferences. settings cannot override local HOME/state mapping. Existing service-URL integration seam is not a second persisted user-config/home authority.
bootstrap_exceptions: HOME and state-root use their separate explicit bootstrap contracts
